title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.12.50: Fixed Vigor breaking under My Own Lesson and Pulled Punch. Vigor pays itself out after an attack, and that payment was being mistaken for an incoming debuff - so it was cancelled and handed back, making Vigor climb instead of being spent, and leaving it permanently unable to add damage for the rest of the combat. Only the part of a negative Strength/Dexterity/Vigor change that actually lands below zero counts as a debuff now; genuine debuffs still invert and soften exactly as before.
